papers.title: Distributed Newton Optimization with ADMM-Based Consensus
papers.authors: G Carnevale, N Bastianello, G Notarstefano, R Carli
papers.abstract: In this paper we propose two novel second-order distributed algorithms for consensus optimization both employing ADMM as a consensus protocol. The idea is to benefit from the robustness properties of ADMM on the one hand, and the enhanced performance of Newton-based algorithms on the other.
